texture_top_matches: top edge of the main unfolded map
orientation: OpenGL +X right, +Y up, +Z out of front face; image scanlines run downward
uv_mapping: One full 0..1 UV rectangle over a 2:1 sheet. No atlas padding or transparency. Use clamp-to-edge.
fold_note: Five accordion panels inferred from the existing 2:1 open sheet and 2:5 cover; shallow alternating ridge/valley creases, not a folding animation.

frequency_split.displacement: Broad fold creases, gentle paper waviness, slight perimeter lift.
frequency_split.normal_full: Normals from the same broad height field plus fine fibrous microrelief.
frequency_split.normal_detail: Microrelief only, for geometry/shaders that already calculate displaced fold normals.

png_color_metadata: No gamma, sRGB or ICC color profile chunks
source_processing: Image-generated grayscale paper grain; band-pass normalization; registered analytical folds; mathematical tangent-space normal encoding. Final texture resolution is 4096x2048; the source image is not native 4K.
